title: FIX: Replace legacy assistant name with ChatGPT repository-wide
body:
Operating Classification: Standalone emergency repository correction
Issue Class: standalone task
Product Authority Direction: Bill, 2026-07-21 3:30 PM EDT
Priority: immediate

## Objective
Replace the retired assistant name with `ChatGPT` everywhere it appears as a case-insensitive whole word in tracked repository text files.

## Delivery
- Delivery model: Model A
- Promotion path: Promotion Candidate -> Production
- Target branch/environment: `main` / production repository authority
- Source main SHA: `79cd47b2f93749ff17348f5aa199f0325b40dfc2`
- Rollback: one-step revert of the resulting merge commit

## Scope and allowlist
Allowed final-diff paths:
- `**/*` only where the source file contains the retired assistant name as a case-insensitive whole word

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every tracked text-file whole-word match for the retired assistant name is replaced with `ChatGPT`.

## Validation
Required builder validation:
- `git grep -n -i -w '' -- .` returns no matches after replacement.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- Final PR changed-file list is reviewed for replacement-only scope.

title: OPS: Add Cursor Bridge health watchdog and missed-handoff reconciliation
deliveryModelStated: Model A unless implementation proves materially larger than one reviewable PR
body:
Operating Classification: Standalone Operations Issue
Delivery Model: Model A unless implementation proves materially larger than one reviewable PR
Profile: Development -> Promotion Candidate -> Production

## Objective

Improve reliability of the existing event-driven Cursor Local Bridge by adding a local Bridge health heartbeat/watchdog and a bounded slow reconciliation sweep.

## Validation

Provide repository and direct-host evidence for healthy heartbeat generation, watchdog recovery, and reconciliation correctness.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Bridge writes a fresh local heartbeat while healthy.
- [ ] One independently reviewed Production PR promotes the complete change to `main`.

## Rollback

- Disable the new watchdog/timer and reconciliation feature flag or interval.
- Restore the prior Bridge service and configuration.
